projects.name: FitProgressr
projects.description: ️ Full-stack MERN fitness tracker with workout logging, weekly streaks, custom goals, XP, and unlockable achievement badges.

caseStudy.usage: 🎯 Log workouts, set weekly day or minute goals, and earn XP and unlock achievement badges as you reach milestones.
tradeoffs: 🌐 Account-backed storage enables cross-device history, with added authentication and setup work.
📊 Streak and goal calculations add query work in exchange for current progress insights.
technicalNeeds: 🗄️ Indexed MongoDB collections support fast workout history and date-range queries.
🔌 Express REST endpoints handle secure sessions, goals, and XP progression.
DX: 🐳 Docker Compose makes the frontend, API, and database reproducible locally.
🔐 JWT-protected REST routes and documented environment setup keep account data flows clear.
UX: 📅 Weekly rhythm and 8-week calendars make training consistency easy to scan.
🏆 Flexible session notes and goals make it clear how to earn XP and unlock achievement badges.
overview: 📝 Log sessions by date and update workout details as plans change.
📆 Track weekly rhythm, an 8-week streak calendar, and custom day or minute goals.
🏆 Earn XP and unlock achievement badges as you reach workout milestones.

highlights: 🎯 Custom goals, XP, and unlockable achievements

projects.name: Ownlyst
projects.description: Privacy-first, 100% browser-local note-taking app with zero server uploads, customizable multi-view workspaces, and one-click JSON/CSV backups.

caseStudy.usage: 📝 Write in a private browser vault, choose a workspace view, personalize it, and export a backup whenever needed.
tradeoffs: 🛡️ A browser-only vault protects privacy, while cross-device moves rely on manual backups.
⚡ No accounts or cloud sync keeps the app immediate and offline-ready, without collaboration features.
technicalNeeds: 💾 IndexedDB and localStorage provide browser-side persistence.
🧲 Drag-and-drop and layout state support multiple workspace views.
📤 Client-side JSON and CSV import/export include profile preferences.
DX: 🧱 Typed models separate views, controllers, storage, and backup schemas.
🧪 Lint, test, and build scripts support a quick local feedback loop.
🐳 Docker and no backend services keep setup self-contained.
UX: 🔒 No accounts or server uploads; notes stay available offline in the browser.
🎨 Themes, avatars, and Grid, Kanban, Table, or Roadmap views adapt the workspace.
📦 JSON and CSV backups support portable ownership and restore.
overview: 🔒 Write in a browser-local vault with no accounts or tracking.
🗂️ Switch between Grid, Kanban, Table, and Roadmap views; personalize themes and avatars.
📦 Export or restore full JSON and CSV backups at any time.

projects.name: Nmoji
projects.description: Fast, local-first emoji search and picker built with Astro and React, featuring virtual scrolling, context-aware suggestions, and a clean one-click clipboard flow.

caseStudy.usage: ⌨️ Search emoji by name, category, or tags; explore related picks and copy in one click.
tradeoffs: 📦 Shipping the emoji dataset adds client assets, while enabling offline, zero-network search.
🧮 Client-side suggestions avoid profiling, with less behavioral personalization.
technicalNeeds: 📚 A static, indexed emoji dataset supports local fuzzy search.
⚡ Virtualized rendering keeps thousands of results responsive.
📋 Clipboard API and persisted theme state support core interactions.
DX: 🧩 Astro shells and React islands isolate interactive search and details.
🧪 A separate extension workspace keeps browser integration alongside the web app.
📦 No external APIs or database make development and testing self-contained.
UX: 🔎 Search and contextual suggestions make emoji discovery quick.
⚡ Virtual scrolling keeps large emoji collections smooth on desktop and mobile.
📋 One-click copy, local-first behavior, and theme support fit everyday writing.
overview: 🔎 Search emoji by name, category, or tags.
✨ Explore related and popular suggestions while viewing emoji details.
📋 Copy in one click with no tracking or remote lookups.

projects.name: Contribution Cards
projects.description: Open-source contributor showcase with live Community Pulse metrics, impact ranking, smart GitHub API caching, and share-ready profile cards.

caseStudy.usage: 👥 Browse builders across repositories, check community metrics, filter and rank contributors, then share a curated card.
tradeoffs: 🧠 Client-side caching limits rate usage, with added revalidation state to manage.
⚡ Aggregating repositories enables instant filtering, while coordinating initial fetches.
technicalNeeds: 🐙 GitHub Contributors API integration uses caching and retry handling.
📈 Client-side aggregation powers cross-repository community metrics.
🌐 Accessible navigation supports English and Spanish.
DX: 🪝 Modular hooks separate API fetching, cache, aggregation, and sorting.
☁️ A serverless, database-free design avoids backend operations.
📚 Repository guidance helps contributors adopt and extend the showcase.
UX: 📊 Community Pulse summarizes builders, contributions, and active repositories.
🔎 Repo filters and impact ranking make contributor discovery quick.
♿ Keyboard support and English/Spanish localization broaden access.
overview: 📊 Monitor Community Pulse, filter by repo, and rank contributors by impact.
🔗 Share curated contributor cards without a backend database.

projects.name: Markdown Shop
projects.description: All-in-one GitHub README toolkit combining a live Markdown workspace, ready-to-use templates, profile visual components, and guided writing prompts.

caseStudy.usage: 📝 Start from a README template, profile component, or writing prompt; edit with live preview and copy the Markdown.
tradeoffs: 🔄 Combining modular inserts with freeform text requires careful editor-state synchronization.
⚡ Live parsing adds per-keystroke work to keep previews current and safe.
technicalNeeds: 🛡️ Marked and DOMPurify render and sanitize Markdown previews.
🧠 Zustand coordinates editor, templates, profile components, and prompts.
DX: 🧱 Composable editor, templates, generators, and prompt libraries simplify additions.
🧼 Isolated Markdown parsing and sanitization separate input from preview.
🚀 CLI scripts, CI, and semantic releases support repeatable delivery.
UX: 👀 Side-by-side editing and preview keep rendered output in view.
🧩 Templates, profile visuals, and writing prompts reduce blank-page effort.
📋 A simple choose, edit, and copy flow needs no account or setup.
overview: 🧩 Start with a project or profile template, GitHub visual, or writing prompt.
✍️ Shape README content in a workspace with side-by-side live preview.
📋 Copy clean Markdown directly to GitHub.
